b1.king_of_destruction_wakes.rumor: Word spreads that the King of Destruction has woken in Reim, far across the sea on Chandrar, after twenty years of slumber.

canon_ref.note: Same evening as the end of 1.24 (Erin knocking on the table), so day 18. The twins appeared the day before. The rumor is a design choice: the text says the news rings across the world.

b1.king_of_destruction_wakes.summary: In ruined Reim, a king who has sat idle for twenty-two years questions two sixteen-year-old twins from Earth. Their tales of a greater world set him on fire. He takes his throne at last, and Flos Reimarch, the King of Destruction, wakes his starving nation to war.
